text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Shuka Sho arrives. With sparks of intense determination flying, Sweep Tosho clashes with her rivals before the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The final race of the Triple Tiara tour—and the last battle Sweep Tosho must overcome to become the star of her year—is about to begin!
